translation.en: What if we should fail?

translation.en: Do you like playing cards?

items.label: interrogative particle
items.explanation: か at the end turns the sentence into a question.

translation.pt-BR: Você é do tipo que se deixa prender pelos hábitos?
translation.en: Are you a creature of habit?

items.label: interrogative particle
items.explanation: か at the end turns the statement です into a polite question.

items.jp: 三つの中から選んで

translation.pt-BR: Escolha dentre os três.
translation.en: Choose from among the three.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から indicates where one chooses from: 'from among the three', marking the source set of the selection.

items.jp: この飛行場は町から遠い

translation.pt-BR: Este aeroporto fica longe da cidade.
translation.en: This airport is far from the city.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から indicates the point from which the distance is measured (from the city). With 遠い, it marks the reference point for 'far'.

items.jp: 窓から光が入ってきます

translation.pt-BR: A luz entra pela janela.
translation.en: Light comes in through the window.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marks the window as the point from which the light comes (from/through the window).

items.jp: ここからお宅まではどれくらいなんですか？

translation.pt-BR: Qual é a distância daqui até a sua casa?
translation.en: How far is it from here to your house?

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca ここ como o ponto de partida da distância que se quer saber.

items.jp: 未来から来ました。

translation.pt-BR: Eu vim do futuro.
translation.en: I come from the future.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca 未来 como o ponto de origem do deslocamento: é de lá que a pessoa veio.

items.jp: 彼はそれからどうなりましたか。

translation.pt-BR: E ele, o que aconteceu com ele depois disso?
translation.en: What has become of him since then?

items.label: particle forming the connector それから
items.explanation: から attached to それ forms それから; here it marks 'since then / after that', placing the question in the time after the already-mentioned event.

items.jp: 彼は１１歳の時から英語の学習をはじめました。

translation.pt-BR: Ele começou a estudar inglês aos onze anos.
translation.en: He started learning English at the age of eleven.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca １１歳の時 como o ponto de partida no tempo: foi daí em diante que ele começou.

items.jp: この引用はどこから持ってきたの？

translation.pt-BR: De onde você tirou essa citação?
translation.en: Where does this quote come from?

items.label: marca de origem
items.explanation: から marca どこ como o ponto de onde a citação foi tirada.

items.jp: ヨーロッパから来たの？

translation.pt-BR: Você veio da Europa?
translation.en: Are you from Europe?

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca ヨーロッパ como o ponto de onde a pessoa veio.

items.jp: 彼から何の便りもない。

translation.pt-BR: Não tive nenhuma notícia dele.
translation.en: I have heard nothing from him.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca 彼 como a origem da notícia que nunca chegou.

items.jp: 猫が部屋から飛び出した。

translation.pt-BR: Um gato saiu disparado do quarto.
translation.en: A cat dashed out of the room.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca 部屋 como o ponto de saída: o gato dispara de dentro do quarto para fora.

items.jp: 入場は何時からですか。

translation.pt-BR: A partir de que horas abre a entrada?
translation.en: What time does the club open?

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca 何時 como o ponto de partida no tempo: a partir de que horas a entrada abre.

items.jp: 少年は母親のハンドバッグからお金を盗んだ。

translation.pt-BR: O menino roubou dinheiro da bolsa da mãe.
translation.en: The boy stole money from his mother's handbag.

items.label: starting point / source
items.explanation: から marks where the money came from: 'from inside the handbag'. Here it indicates the physical origin from which something is taken.

items.jp: 書物から大きな楽しみが得られます。

translation.pt-BR: Dá para tirar um grande prazer dos livros.
translation.en: We can derive great pleasure from books.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca 書物 como a fonte de onde o prazer é tirado.

items.jp: 子供は１３歳から１６歳の間で急速に成長する。

translation.pt-BR: A criança cresce rápido entre os 13 e os 16 anos.
translation.en: A child develops rapidly between the ages of 13 and 16.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca １３歳 como o começo da faixa: forma com 間 o intervalo em que o crescimento é rápido.

items.jp: 月曜から木曜までここにおります。

translation.pt-BR: Fico aqui de segunda a quinta.
translation.en: I will be here from Monday to Thursday.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca 月曜 como o começo do intervalo: forma com まで o par que diz de quando até quando.

items.jp: 月は地球から遠い。

translation.pt-BR: A Lua é longe da Terra.
translation.en: The moon is distant from the earth.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca 地球 como o ponto de referência da distância: é a partir da Terra que a Lua fica longe.

items.jp: 空港行きの次の電車は二番ホームから出ます。

translation.pt-BR: O próximo trem para o aeroporto sai da plataforma dois.
translation.en: The next train to the airport departs from platform 2.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca 二番ホーム como o ponto de partida do trem.

items.jp: 愛は家庭から始まる。

translation.pt-BR: O amor começa em casa.
translation.en: Charity begins at home.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca 家庭 como o ponto de partida: é dentro de casa que o amor começa.

items.jp: それから彼はメガネをはずした。

translation.pt-BR: Depois disso, ele tirou os óculos.
translation.en: He took off his glasses after that.

items.label: particle forming the connector それから
items.explanation: から attached to それ forms それから; here it marks 'after that / next', connecting this action to a previous event in the narrative.

items.jp: それからニッケルを取るよ。

translation.pt-BR: Depois disso, eu tiro o níquel.
translation.en: Then I'd take the nickel out.

items.label: particle forming the connector それから
items.explanation: から attached to それ forms それから; here it marks the sequence 'from that / next', placing this action after something previous.

items.jp: その組は５０人の生徒からなる。

translation.pt-BR: Essa turma tem 50 alunos.
translation.en: The class consists of 50 boys.

items.label: particle of origin/starting point
items.explanation: から marca ５０人の生徒 como aquilo de que a turma é composta; 〜からなる é 'ser formado por'.

items.jp: その青年は向かいの家から出てきた。

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 背中 as what is in pain; with adjectives of physical sensation like 痛い, が is used to point to the affected body part.

items.jp: クラスの中で彼が一番背が高い

translation.pt-BR: Na turma, ele é o mais alto.
translation.en: In the class, he's the tallest.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 背 (height) as the grammatical subject of 高い; 背が高い is the fixed way of saying 'to be tall'.
tokens: grammatical subject of 高い (in the expression 背が高い = to be tall)

items.jp: 兄は私より背が高いです

translation.pt-BR: Meu irmão mais velho é mais alto que eu.
translation.en: My older brother is taller than me.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 背 (height) as that which is in fact tall; in the expression 背が高い the adjective describes the 背, not the person directly.

items.jp: 外がうるさくて寝られない

translation.pt-BR: Lá fora está tão barulhento que não consigo dormir.
translation.en: It's so noisy outside that I can't sleep.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 外 (outside) as the subject that is noisy. が is used here because it presents a situation observed on the spot.

items.jp: 来月、国際会議があります

translation.pt-BR: No mês que vem vai ter uma conferência internacional.
translation.en: There's going to be an international conference next month.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が presents 国際会議 as new information that exists; with existence verbs like ある, what exists is normally marked by が.
tokens: core of the subject (compound 国際会議)

items.jp: 母が出かけている間に宿題を終えた

translation.pt-BR: Terminei a lição de casa enquanto minha mãe estava fora.
translation.en: I finished my homework while my mother was out.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 母 as the subject of the subordinate clause (who was out). Within clauses with 間に, the internal subject usually takes が, not は.
tokens: noun that forms the expression 間に

items.jp: 友達のお兄さんは背が高い

translation.pt-BR: O irmão mais velho do meu amigo é alto.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marca 背 'estatura' como o sujeito específico que é alto, dentro do tópico maior (o irmão). É o padrão は…が… para descrever uma parte/característica.

items.jp: 彼がどこに行ったか知らない

translation.pt-BR: Eu não sei aonde ele foi.
translation.en: I don't know where he went.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 彼 as the subject of 行く within the inner clause; in subordinate/embedded clauses the subject usually comes with が, not は.
tokens: interrogative pronoun (core of the embedded question)

items.jp: 庭で小鳥が鳴いている

translation.pt-BR: Um passarinho está cantando no jardim.
translation.en: A little bird is singing in the garden.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 小鳥 as the subject performing the action, presenting it as new information (a little bird).

items.jp: 方々に花がさいている

translation.pt-BR: Tem flor desabrochando por toda parte.
translation.en: Flowers are blooming here and there.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marca 花 como o sujeito de さく, isto é, quem faz ou de quem se diz o que o predicado exprime.

items.jp: バスより電車のほうが速い

translation.pt-BR: O trem é mais rápido que o ônibus.
translation.en: The train is faster than the bus.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 電車のほう as the subject of 速い: it is the train side that is fast.
tokens: supporting noun (ほう, marks the preferred alternative)

items.jp: 窓の外に小鳥が来た

translation.pt-BR: Um passarinho veio para o lado de fora da janela.
translation.en: A little bird came outside the window.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 小鳥 as the subject that came, presenting it as new information.

items.jp: 公園で子どもたちが遊んでいた

translation.pt-BR: As crianças estavam brincando no parque.
translation.en: The children were playing in the park.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 子どもたち as those who perform the action; it introduces the subject that was playing.

items.jp: 明日は忙しい。それと来週も時間がない

translation.pt-BR: Amanhã eu tô ocupado. E também não tenho tempo na semana que vem.
translation.en: I'm busy tomorrow. And on top of that, I have no time next week either.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marca 時間 como o sujeito de ない, isto é, quem faz ou de quem se diz o que o predicado exprime.

items.jp: 薬を飲んだ　すると頭が痛くなくなった

translation.pt-BR: Tomei o remédio e, então, a dor de cabeça passou.
translation.en: I took the medicine, and then my headache went away.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 頭 (the head) as the subject that went through the change of state (stopped hurting). が is used because it describes an observed event.

items.jp: 天気が直って外で遊べた

translation.pt-BR: O tempo melhorou e a gente pôde brincar lá fora.
translation.en: The weather cleared up and we were able to play outside.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 天気 as the subject that 'improved'.

items.jp: 駅の右側に銀行があります

translation.pt-BR: Do lado direito da estação tem um banco.
translation.en: On the right side of the station there's a bank.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 「銀行」as that whose existence is asserted with あります.

items.jp: 彼はいつも格好がいい

translation.pt-BR: Ele está sempre com um visual bacana.
translation.en: He always looks sharp.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 格好 as that which is いい. In the construction 'Xは Yがいい', が points to the specific thing (the appearance) that receives the positive evaluation.

items.jp: 昨夜雨が降りました

translation.pt-BR: Ontem à noite choveu.
translation.en: It rained last night.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 雨 as the subject performing the action of falling; with natural phenomena が is used, not は.

items.jp: 耳が少し痛いです

translation.pt-BR: Meu ouvido está doendo um pouco.
translation.en: My ear hurts a little.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 耳 as the subject that feels the pain; with sensation adjectives like 痛い, what hurts takes が.

items.jp: 朝から雨が降っていた

translation.pt-BR: Estava chovendo desde a manhã.
translation.en: It had been raining since morning.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 雨 as that which performs the action of falling; 降る is intransitive and its natural subject takes が.

items.jp: 食べ過ぎでお腹が痛い

translation.pt-BR: Estou com dor de barriga de tanto comer.
translation.en: My stomach hurts from eating too much.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks お腹 as what is hurting; with sensation adjectives like 痛い, the affected body part takes が.

items.jp: 中学校の２年生が職場体験をしました

translation.pt-BR: Os alunos do segundo ano do ensino fundamental II fizeram uma experiência de trabalho.
translation.en: The junior high 8th graders went to observe workplaces.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 中学校の２年生 as the subject that performs the action of doing the work experience.

items.jp: 私が予約をした

translation.pt-BR: Eu fiz a reserva.
translation.en: I made a reservation.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 私 (I) as the subject who performed the action. Here が highlights who made the reservation.

items.jp: やはり経験がものを言います

translation.pt-BR: No fim das contas, é a experiência que faz a diferença.
translation.en: Experience really does make the difference.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 経験 ('experience') as the subject that 'speaks/carries weight'. が is used, not は, because the sentence highlights precisely experience as the decisive factor (focus on the subject).

items.jp: それが私たちの生活に大きな関わりを持っています

translation.pt-BR: Isso tem muito a ver com a nossa vida.
translation.en: It has a lot to do with our life.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks それ as the subject of the sentence (that which has the relationship), presenting it as new/focused information.

items.jp: 私にはまったく関係が無い

translation.pt-BR: Comigo não tem nada a ver.
translation.en: It has nothing to do with me at all.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 関係 as the subject of 無い (that which does not exist: the relationship).

items.jp: この期間が３ヶ月と言われています

translation.pt-BR: Dizem que esse período dura três meses.
translation.en: It's said this period lasts for three months.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks この期間 as the subject about which the statement is made ('what is said to be three months').

items.jp: 彼が必ずチェックを入れます

translation.pt-BR: Ele sempre confere tudo direitinho.
translation.en: He is sure to check.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 彼 (he) as the subject that performs the action. Here が (instead of は) gives a slight focus on the agent, as in 'it's he who always checks'.

items.jp: 私が今こうして、二日分の日記を書く

translation.pt-BR: Agora, é assim que eu escrevo o diário de dois dias de uma vez.
translation.en: Now I write two days' worth of diary entries like this.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 私 ('I') as the subject, with emphasis on who does the action. The use of が (instead of は) highlights the speaker themselves as agent in this specific scene.

items.jp: 一人一人がしっかりと社会のルールを守る

translation.pt-BR: Cada um respeita direitinho as regras da sociedade.
translation.en: Each one strictly observes the social codes.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 一人一人 ('each one') as the subject that performs the action of following the rules.

items.jp: 男性がなにやら話を始めた

translation.pt-BR: Um homem começou a falar sobre não sei o quê.
translation.en: The man started talking about something.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 男性 ('the man') as the one who performs the action of starting to talk. It introduces a new subject, not yet known, rather than an already-given topic.
tokens: pronoun (part of なにやら, 'I don't know what')

items.jp: なかなかいい感じで話が進む

translation.pt-BR: A conversa vai indo muito bem.
translation.en: The conversation continues in a friendly way.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 話 (conversation) as the subject that performs the action of 進む (to advance). が is used because it introduces/highlights the subject of a concrete event.

items.jp: 彼が３０日と２２日の２度、会場に足を運びました

translation.pt-BR: Ele foi ao local do evento duas vezes, nos dias 30 e 22.
translation.en: He visited the site twice, on the 30th and 22nd.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 彼 (he) as the subject that performs the action of going to the place. It presents the agent of the sentence.

items.jp: 母親が一人で四人の子供を育てた

translation.pt-BR: A mãe criou quatro filhos sozinha.
translation.en: The mother raised 4 children by herself.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 母親 as the subject that performs the action of raising the children.

items.jp: 彼が早めに何らかの手を打つ

translation.pt-BR: Ele vai tomar alguma providência com antecedência.
translation.en: He'll do something about it beforehand.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 彼 ('he') as the one who performs the action of taking the measure.
tokens: pronoun/base of the adnominal expression 何らかの

items.jp: 彼が空港ですぐレンタカーを借ります

translation.pt-BR: Ele vai alugar um carro logo no aeroporto.
translation.en: He'll immediately rent a car at the airport.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks 彼 (he) as the subject that performs the action of renting.

items.jp: いよいよ１７日の国際フェアトレード・デーが近付きました

translation.pt-BR: Finalmente, o Dia Internacional do Comércio Justo, no dia 17, está chegando.
translation.en: Finally, the International Fair Trade Day on the 17th is around corner.

items.label: subject particle
items.explanation: が marks the whole phrase '国際フェアトレード・デー' ('International Fair Trade Day') as the subject that is approaching.
tokens: part of the proper name (fair trade)
part of the proper name (fair trade)
